verdict: PARTIAL for onboarding (no first-run content in the box); STRONG for the hit-pause rule (first hit feedback)
depth_note: Onboarding is thin: the engine has no module content. Hit-pause rule read in full.
rule: Per landed hit, in order: flash spawns at the target; combo timer starts; the attacker gets a pause only if its pause window has ended or it is airborne (with the air flag off); the victim always gets the same pause, applied to its movement timer, animation timer and think timer.

data_fields.name: pause_add
data_fields.unit: engine ticks (same clock as the game timer; inferred)

keep: Victim stun is unconditional on a landed hit
Attacker recovery is gated by a window on the ground, so combos do not freeze the attacker
Explicit air rule (donor default bypasses the window; ours should be a data flag)
Attract loop: a six-second hold that any button skips, then a logo, then an intro that replays every 20 seconds and resets on menu input
Blinking PRESS START over the attract art
Drop-in join on any button per slot, with lives reset to the set value
change: Pause is written into four timer fields by hand; use one pause field per entity read by movement, animation and think
The donor comment marks the attacker timer write as temporary (line 31733): do not keep the comment, keep the rule
Quake applies on bounce only, not on each hit: do not copy as hit shake
Menu order and five items: our menu is ours to design

first_90_seconds: Boot: six-second hold skipped by any button, then the logo scene, then the intro scene, then PRESS START over the intro art. The scene files are not in the repo (media/ holds only _DUMMY), so what the player sees is not known for any shipped module.
first_fight_and_kill: Staged by module data (not in the box). No first-kill gate in the engine.
first_hit_feedback: Flash at the target, combo timer, victim stun, attacker recovery gate (engine half, read in full). Shake only on bounce. Fall sound and pad rumble on landing.
idle_and_ambient: Attract loop replays the intro scene every 20 seconds; menu input pushes the next replay out.
death_and_respawn: Death sequence can blink the dying entity (per-model flags, no-blink command exists). Players switch to a player blink action on death. Continues come from the level set, with a global default of five. Respawn and continue screens not read.
readability_375: Not verified. Menu uses three font slots (menu/font1-3) on a fixed cell grid.
